description: This source file defines the DocumentObjectCollectionDescriptor class, which provides metadata and access methods for DocumentObjectCollection properties within the MigraDoc.DocumentObjectModel.Internals namespace. It enables getting, setting, null-checking, and managing property values associated with DocumentObjectCollection in a document object model context.

classes.name: DocumentObjectCollectionDescriptor
classes.description: A descriptor class for DocumentObjectCollection properties, providing methods to get, set, null-check, and manage collection properties associated with DocumentObject in the document object model.

methods.name: GetValue
methods.description: Retrieves the DocumentObjectCollection value from a DocumentObject, optionally creating and initializing it if not present and flags permit.

methods.name: SetValue
methods.description: Sets the DocumentObjectCollection value for a given DocumentObject.

methods.name: SetNull
methods.description: Sets the associated DocumentObjectCollection to null.

methods.name: IsNull
methods.description: Checks if the DocumentObjectCollection property of a DocumentObject is null or considered null according to its internal state.
